text: On the left flank near the halfway line at the Kingsmoor FC defending end, Felix Barros commits a foul for the second time, resulting in a red card at the 81st minute. This leaves Kingsmoor down to ten players while trailing 2-3 against Westport Albion. Westport’s direct vertical pressure continues as Kingsmoor struggles to maintain their wide crossing style without Barros. Kingsmoor hold 50.3% possession but have not managed any shots on target in the last ten minutes. [#1494] [#1495]
